project: Knowledge-Tracing-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Exercise Selection

features.name: Question and Knowledge Component Metadata
features.expected_behavior: Canonical 52-question bank with stable item_ids, 30 canonical KCs, 1-5 difficulty ratings, and prerequisite DAG.
features.integration_status: Fully integrated into static resources, quiz generator, and RL environment.
features.evidence: 6 unit tests pass validating 52 stable items, 30 KCs, and 0 prerequisite cycles.

features.name: Persistent SQLite Learning Event Store
features.expected_behavior: Transactional persistence of learner interaction events, session tracking, response times, and state snapshots.
features.integration_status: Active database with tables learning_events, learning_sessions, and learner_states.
features.evidence: 5 unit tests pass confirming foreign-key enforcement, idempotent insertion, and deterministic retrieval.

features.name: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) Engine
features.expected_behavior: Sequential Bayesian mastery updates P(K) after each answer, chronological history replay, and per-KC belief tracking.
features.integration_status: Exposed via /api/learning/mastery endpoints and visualized in the React Dashboard Knowledge Tracing tab.
features.evidence: 9 unit tests pass verifying Bayesian update math, prior bounds, and multi-KC independent updates.

features.name: Synthetic Student Simulator
features.expected_behavior: Simulates 4 student archetypes (fast, typical, struggling, inconsistent) with sigmoid response models, learning, and forgetting.
features.integration_status: Encapsulated in ExerciseSelectionEnv; strictly isolated from observable policy state.
features.evidence: 14 tests pass confirming fixed-seed reproducibility, response probabilities, and ground-truth encapsulation.

features.name: Gymnasium-Compatible RL Environment & State Encoder
features.expected_behavior: 99-dim observable state, Discrete(52) action space, prerequisite action masking, and multi-objective reward function.
features.integration_status: Full 5-tuple step interface used by training pipelines and baseline diagnostics.
features.evidence: Environment reset and step contracts verified with 0 prerequisite violations under action masking.

features.name: Dueling Deep Q-Network Agent & Training Pipeline
features.expected_behavior: Dueling architecture V(s) and A(s, a), Double DQN target bootstrapping, action-masked exploration/exploitation, and replay memory.
features.evidence: 6 unit tests pass validating dueling mathematical aggregation, Double DQN targets, and checkpoint roundtrips.

features.name: Comprehensive Evaluation & Ablation Studies
features.expected_behavior: Held-out evaluation comparing Dueling DQN against 4 baselines, and ablation of Double DQN, rewards, and action masks.
features.integration_status: Machine-readable reports generated in reports/phase5_evaluation.json and phase5_ablation_results.json.
features.evidence: 100-episode held-out evaluation confirms Dueling DQN does not outperform prereq_aware_weakest heuristic.

features.name: Experimental Recommendation Endpoint & Safety Gatekeeper
features.expected_behavior: Opt-in endpoint POST /api/experimental/recommendation gated by KT_RL_EXPERIMENT_ENABLED (default disabled) with heuristic fallback.
features.integration_status: Route registered in app.py with safety fallback to baseline.
features.evidence: Unit tests pass verifying flag defaulting to disabled and graceful fallback on missing checkpoints.

features.name: Forgetting-Aware Exercise Selection
features.expected_behavior: Estimates retention decay based on elapsed time since last practice and prioritizes revision for previously mastered topics.
features.integration_status: Not yet integrated into a unified adaptive recommendation service.
features.evidence: Simulator implements forgetting, but observable live recommender lacks longitudinal retention modeling.

features.name: Confidence- & Uncertainty-Aware Selection
features.expected_behavior: Distinguishes between high/low mastery and high/low evidence; prioritizes informative assessment for high-uncertainty KCs.
features.integration_status: Evidence quality badges exist on BKT states, but policy doesn't use it to balance exploration vs exploitation.
features.evidence: Evidence quality is logged, but recommendation policies currently only inspect mean mastery probability.

features.name: Frustration-Aware & Disengagement Risk Mitigation
features.expected_behavior: Detects consecutive topic failures and prolonged response times, automatically adjusting difficulty and providing remedial practice.
features.integration_status: Present in RL reward penalty; missing from live rule-based recommendation logic.
features.evidence: Reward penalizes consecutive failures in simulation, but live recommender does not adaptively back off.

features.name: Unified Adaptive Recommendation Service
features.expected_behavior: Single modular service coordinating BKT, forgetting, confidence, frustration, and prerequisite policies with structured explanations.
features.integration_status: Currently fragmented between rl_diagnostics, experimental_recommendation_service, and catalog_service.
features.evidence: To be implemented in Phase D.

features.name: Frontend Real-Time Adaptive Recommendation Card
features.expected_behavior: Displays recommended next exercise, pedagogical rationale, mastery status, and evidence quality in dashboard and quiz pages.
features.integration_status: Dashboard displays BKT state, but live adaptive recommendation card is not yet rendered.
features.evidence: UI needs an interactive adaptive recommendation card connected to the new recommendation endpoint.
